article.toolCalling.label: Flowchart from gameplay footage to a game design document
article.toolCalling.step.prepare: Node.js extracts one frame per second from the MP4. Three minutes yields 180 frames.
article.toolCalling.step.prompt: Node.js sends the task and the definition of get_video_frames to the model.
article.toolCalling.step.call: The model requests the first 12 frames. The API returns the function name, arguments, and call_id.
article.toolCalling.step.result: Node.js reads frames 0–11 and returns the images with their timestamps and the same call_id.
article.toolCalling.step.continue: The model analyzes the frames and requests the next batch, 12–23. This repeats until the end of the segment.
article.toolCalling.step.document: The model turns the observations from the entire recording into one game design document.
